selected_evidence.requirement: Configure `/srv/drop` as a shared writable sticky directory
selected_evidence.summary: Direct stat output shows `/srv/drop` is owned by root:root with mode 1777; final verification also confirms no test artifacts remain.

selected_evidence.requirement: Users cannot remove files owned by other users
selected_evidence.summary: Before and after restart, cross-user deletion failed with `Operation not permitted`, while file owners could delete their own files.

selected_evidence.requirement: Retain the installed legacy OS release and kernel
selected_evidence.summary: Ubuntu 16.04 and kernel 4.4.0-210-generic were observed unchanged before and after configuration and restart.

Healthy baseline boot ID was `35c87ec9-1707-4fb3-ab1d-f264d3618caa`; the native reboot was acknowledged; post-restart boot ID changed to `3b983a10-407a-4959-bc71-2e39a2e53d83`; permissions, writable ext4 storage, persisted data, and sticky-directory behavior all recovered.
